claims: C1 the system may apply additional precautions at a system level for user-directed misuse
C2 such precautions include blocking specific requests, monitoring for unusual activity, and responding to reports on the use of unauthorized content
C3 these mitigations are beyond the scope of the Model Spec

concepts.name: system_level_precaution
concepts.gloss: P is a precaution applied at the system level, beyond the assistant's own behavior
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of precautions 'at a system level', which presupposes a class of system-level mitigations distinct from assistant-level behavior

concepts.name: user_directed_misuse
concepts.gloss: M is misuse directed by the user, such as using the service in ways that violate other people's rights
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'user-directed misuse' without defining it; the surrounding text ties it to using the service in ways that violate others' rights

concepts.name: addresses_misuse
concepts.gloss: precaution P is applied in response to or to address misuse M
concepts.inference: the clause lists precautions 'for' user-directed misuse, which requires a relation between a precaution and the misuse it addresses

concepts.name: transformation_exception_rule
concepts.gloss: R is the transformation exception rule: the assistant should comply with limited requests to transform or analyze user-provided content even if the output would ordinarily be disallowed as restricted or sensitive content
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's own text does not state the transformation-exception rule

asserts.read_back: applying system-level precaution % is permitted when it addresses user-directed misuse %

closure.reason: the clause permits applying system-level precautions for user-directed misuse; it does not forbid any precaution, so silence leaves other precautions permitted
